req.title: Redirect-to rejects invalid URL
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 400 when the 'url' parameter of /redirect-to is missing or malformed.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that /redirect-to must return HTTP 400 when the 'url' parameter is missing or malformed. The violations indicate that tests at indices 4, 5, 6, and 8 are missing explicit traces to R-HTTPBIN-027. All tests are preserved from the original response; the only change is adding 'R-HTTPBIN-027' trace entries to the four violating tests (indices 4, 5, 6, and 8). The truncated test[8] from the previous response is also completed here.

tests.name: test_redirect_to_valid_url_returns_302_with_location
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
GET /redirect-to?url=https://example.com is a valid request with a well-formed url parameter

tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

r = client.get('/redirect-to?url=https://example.com')
assert r.status_code == 302, f'Expected 302, got {r.status_code}'
assert r.headers['Location'] == 'https://example.com', f'Expected Location https://example.com, got {r.headers.get("Location")}'

tests.name: test_redirect_to_location_header_exact_url_preserved
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
GET /redirect-to?url=https://httpbin.org/get?a=1&b=2 with a complex URL containing query parameters
actions: GET /redirect-to with a complex url containing query string characters
expected: Location header exactly matches the provided complex URL
trace: R-HTTPBIN-027: positive path — complex url with query params is preserved verbatim in Location header
Catches mutation: URL encoding applied incorrectly or Location value truncated
Catches mutation: Location header set to a different value
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import urllib.parse
client = app.test_client()

target_url = 'https://httpbin.org/get?a=1&b=2'
encoded = urllib.parse.quote(target_url, safe='')
r = client.get(f'/redirect-to?url={encoded}')
assert r.status_code == 302, f'Expected 302, got {r.status_code}'
location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
assert location == target_url, f'Expected Location {target_url!r}, got {location!r}'
